name: sol-advisor
description: Haru fork of Sol Advisor with GPT-6.1 Sol / High primary orchestration and Luna-first execution roles.

interface.shortDescription: Sol architects and integrates; Luna handles routine exploration, implementation, testing, and research.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps GPT-6.1 Sol / High as the primary architect, decomposer, integrator, and final acceptance owner. Non-trivial routine execution is Luna-first: GPT-6 Luna / Max explorers map repositories, workers implement bounded changes with local edit/verify/repair loops, testers reproduce and verify behavior, and researchers handle substantive self-contained read-only investigation. GPT-5.6 Terra / High is reserved for judgment-heavy implementation or research that exceeds a bounded Luna contract. Fresh GPT-6.1 Sol / High review is reserved for high-risk final scrutiny. All auxiliary roles keep explicit model pins, fresh context with fork_turns: none, runtime evidence checks, and fail-closed installation.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare the route before task tools. Keep architecture and final acceptance in GPT-6.1 Sol / High, and use Luna-first explorer, worker, tester, and researcher roles for non-trivial routine execution.
Use Terra only when a bounded Luna role returns concrete judgment-heavy limitations, and use a fresh Sol reviewer only for high-risk final scrutiny.
